source: Eadweard Muybridge, Animal Locomotion: an electro-photographic investigation of consecutive phases of animal movements, 1872-1885, vol. X Domestic Animals, plates 704-710 (Philadelphia: University of Pennsylvania, 1887)
licence: Public domain (1887 publication; Muybridge d. 1904). Commons tags all files "Public domain".

conventions.contact: 1 = paw on ground, 0 = in the air, "?" = unclear
conventions.sides: lateral cameras show the dog moving to the RIGHT, so its RIGHT side faces the camera: near (brighter, less occluded) limbs scored as RF/RH, far limbs as LF/LH. For the gallops the L/R labels follow this near/far reading plus Muybridge 1893 ("lands upon the left fore foot, the right fore will next touch the ground ... land upon the right hind foot ... the left hind now descends"); treat L/R identity as assumed, the fore/hind order and the contact pattern as observed.
conventions.duty_factor: fraction of frames in stance on this plate (duty_known ignores "?"; duty_min counts "?" as 0, duty_max as 1). Plates hold 1-2 strides at coarse sampling, so expect +/-0.1 or worse.
conventions.frame_index: Muybridge frame number as printed on the plate (lateral series)

plates.label_status: L/R confirmed. Near side = dog's right (dog moves right; scale numerals read normally, so the print is not mirrored). Far limbs are darker; planted paws were tracked against the numbered floor scale (a planted paw keeps its scale value). Two contacts flipped (frame 9 RH 1->0, frame 12 LF 1->0), frame 12 RF downgraded 1->?, six unknowns resolved (f1 LH, f4 RF, f5 LF, f6 LH, f11 LH, f12 RH).
plates.gait_reading: Frames 3-7: lateral-sequence walk, LH(3) LF(4) RH(5) RF(7); limb phase about 1 interval / 4-interval hind stride = 0.25 (quantisation +/-0.12). From frame 7 the diagonal pairs land together (LH+RF at 7, RH+LF at 10): the dog breaks into a trot, which fits the catalogue "trotting, interrupted" and Muybridge 1902 "an irregular stride".

stride_estimates.note: about 5 intervals of 0.110 s; frame quantisation +/-0.055 s per event

plates.label_status: CHANGED: every L/R label was mirrored in 05. Corrected sequence LH, RH, RF, LF, then one suspension: still a rotary gallop (as Muybridge 1902 captions Series 57), but the lead hind is RIGHT and the lead fore is LEFT. Confirmed by near-thigh and near-shoulder occlusion in the lateral frames and by the rear-oblique row (frames 3-4).

plates.label_status: UNCERTAIN, unchanged. Motion blur hides which leg is near. The 05 labels were chosen to fit Muybridge 1893's generic description (right hind lands first), and that choice proved mirrored on both other checkable plates (707, Maggie A). Treat L/R here as 50/50: the observed fore/hind order and the contact counts stand; the mirror (LH, RH / RF, LF) is equally likely.
